fields.name: ShardDataConnection<TConfiguration> RunAsync(Query) family
fields.contract: For a Query contract that returns no data result, RunAsync executes it against this shard and completes, or throws on failure. Variants select whether a named parameter is bound to the endpoint's current shard identifier before execution. The sibling RunAsync(ShardBatch<TResult>, CancellationToken) overload is a separate family: it executes a multi-command ShardBatch within one transaction and returns the batch's declared TResult.
